decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): Read with its section, the cited item is not vague. [ev-131accbf2c98] names the deprecated policy-level settings: spec.validationFailureAction, spec.validationFailureActionOverrides, spec.mutateExistingOnPolicyUpdate and spec.generateExisting. [ev-bc2d5eccce0f] names the per-rule fields that replace them, and the CRD diffs show those fields were added in 1.13.0 to Policy and ClusterPolicy v1 and v2beta1 (e.g. [ev-236984661abb], [ev-af63781cf017], [ev-d4e55a3c3ecb]). [ev-963b8a5003cf] gives the consequence: the old fields are deprecated, not removed, and will only be removed in a future release, so migration is recommended. That means the change is a deprecation with replacedBy, exposure is any policy using the old spec-level fields, and nothing breaks now. Confidence is low because the text pairs each old field with its new one only by name, and no excerpt shows a CRD diff for mutate.mutateExisting.
